svg.title: A / WHITE neutral
svg.desc: Harness revision 14: ferrule branches at F1 LOAD, K5 power terminal 3 and K1 power terminal 3. One ferrule enters the clamp at each shared endpoint. Small AC terminals each receive one 14 AWG wire in a blue ferrule. Rail order W1, K1, W2, K5, K4, PS1, F1; sheet 07 is an enlarged GPIO connection view. Four box leads: black A01, white A08, red B04, green A17 to the PS1 FG terminal.
svg.text: BOX N → Finder K5 terminal 3 → Finder K1 terminal 3 · separate single-blue leads to all four neutral loads
WHITE = stranded 14 AWG · branch at POWER terminal 3 · all A1/A2 and Mean Well N ends are SINGLE BLUE
SINGLE = one conductor · SHARED = listed conductors in ONE ferrule · FITTED = as built · DATA = remaining specification

svg.text: A11 IN + A15 to K1 A2 + A16 to K4 A2.
Over Finder rating: reference build only.
K1 A2 gets only A15 in one blue ferrule.
A08 IN + A11 bridge + A13 + A14.
A13 → PS1 N. A14 → K5 A2; each single blue.
Over Finder rating: reference build only.
No neutral path crosses a contact
A11 is a real wire between the two terminal 3s.
Both terminal 4s have no external wire.
A closed 3–4 contact only makes its empty 4 neutral.
A1/A2 are coil terminals, distinct from 1/2/3/4. Both coils retain neutral in every contactor state.
WIRE BY ID · follow the end-preparation notes and assembly checkout · crossings do not connect
